title: SB 348 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to elections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(a)(1) (rewritten)
(quote) After July 1, 2025, a person registering to vote in this state shall submit, along with the registration forms, proof that the applicant is a United States citizen for purposes of voting in elections in this state. Proof of citizenship required must be an original or a true and correct copy of a document listed in subdivisions (b)(1)–(4).
(section) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(a)(2)
(quote) The coordinator of elections shall compare monthly the statewide voter registration database with the department of safety database to ensure non-United States citizens are not registered to vote in this state.
(section) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(b)(1)-(4)
(quote) (1) The voter's birth certificate or a legible photocopy of the voter's birth certificate; (2) The voter's United States passport or a legible photocopy of the pertinent pages of the voter's United States passport, identifying the voter and showing the passport number; (3) The voter's United States naturalization documentation or a legible photocopy of the voter's United States naturalization documentation; or (4) A document or method of proof of citizenship established by the federal Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(a)(3)
(quote) If the coordinator of elections is not able to verify the citizenship of an individual who has applied to register to vote prior to the registration deadline, the individual may only vote a provisional ballot, which must not be counted until the individual's citizenship is verified.
(section) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(b)
(quote) A registered voter who receives a notice pursuant to subdivision (a)(4)(B) shall, no later than thirty (30) days after the receipt of such notice, provide proof of citizenship to the county election commission.
(section) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(c)
(quote) the administrator of elections of the county where the person is registered to vote shall purge the voter from the voter registration database, but shall permanently maintain the person's registration and voting history.
(section) Sec. 2, 2-2-201(2)(C)
(quote) Shall include a statement that specifies each eligibility requirement for voting as set forth in this title, including an attestation that the applicant meets each such requirement, including citizenship and the validity of the applicant's social security number, and that requires the signature of the applicant under penalty of perjury;
(other) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(a)(2): coordinator MAY also compare the voter list with federal and state agency databases, including SAVE, the social security database, naturalization records, public health and public assistance records and county records.
(other) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(a)(3): citizenship of registered voters must be verified before early voting begins.
(other) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(a)(4): flagged voters get monthly notice to state and county commissions, then a certified-mail notice within 5 business days.
(other) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(d): appeal to the state election commission within 14 days; hearing under the Uniform Administrative Procedures Act; the voter stays on the list during a timely appeal.
(other) Sec. 1, 2-2-141(e): commission orders and documents are confidential, except an order finding non-citizenship is public; coordinator reports non-citizens to the district attorney general.
(other) Sec. 2, 2-2-201(2)(D): registration form made available to the commission office and coordinator to ensure compliance with 2-2-141.
(other) Sec. 3: effective July 1, 2025.
(other) version: 3085191-Draft (only saved version): slot d (proof of citizenship with registration after 7/1/2025 for everyone registering; monthly database comparison; flagged voters must prove citizenship in 30 days or be purged) and slot e (provisional ballot until citizenship verified; attestation incl. SSN validity). Slots a-c not stated.
(other) note: Two layers of proof: everyone registering after 7/1/2025 submits citizenship proof with the form (a)(1), and a registered voter flagged by the database comparison must supply proof within 30 days of notice ((a)(4), (b)). The caption names House companion HB0202. No votes. Draft text only.
